4) $NTSK - Netskope

The inspection layer on the AI traffic itself. $202 million quarter, up 28%. ARR at $845 million, up 29%. CEO Sanjay Beri said most organizations deploying AI have little or no way to do it securely, and that Netskope was built to close that gap for autonomous agents. IPO'd at $19 last September. The market still prices them like a late SSE IPO. Beri is describing the checkpoint for every prompt that leaves the building.
